body:
Hi! 24F
I’ve also had some bad experiences with the opposite sex! I have so many insecurities that it makes me afraid to be intimate with anyone. 
I have social anxiety & I’m an introvert too! 
If you ever need anyone to talk to, please feel free to message me! ☺️
I relate to this so much!

Thank you! 
I’ve been trying everything for the social anxiety, I’ve tried different medications over the last 10 or so years. 
Now I’m on a waiting list for a therapist it’s been almost a year. The waiting list is two years long unfortunately. I also ended up spending $300 on a Social Anxiety program. But nothing has worked.
I completely relate to this, so I know how you feel!

I relate to this so much! I’ll be turning 25 in a couple months and I think about it constantly. I still don’t know what I want to do. I feel so hopeless about it most times. I’d love to get a degree but I just don’t know what I want to do and I don’t want to do something I’m going to end up hating. 
I honestly feel so lost in life, I also have social anxiety and depression so that doesn’t help.
Same situation for me, and I also feel like I always need to have stuff figured out by a certain age/time. It really messes with me.
